items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: Uh, Wellington Knox. Yeah. He gave up the clarinet. ... Is he any relation to Mr. Knox who plays drum in the Young Tuxedo band with Casabin? Uh, no. I don't think there's any relation, no.
